rationale: The plan correctly refuses count models, fits limma on log2(TPM+1) with an explicit ~0+condition design and lesional-control contrast, applies no further normalization or size factors, and uses BH at 0.05, but it omits trend=TRUE in eBayes (the key limma-trend adjustment for non-count data) and never asks the core for the raw counts or quant directories. QC has a PCA colored by condition but no sample-distance heatmap and no stated outlier policy; the TPM>=1 in >=5 samples filter is reasonable though slightly looser than the smallest group size of 6. The Wilcoxon cross-check with n=6/group adds little. Enrichment was not asked; the fgsea/ORA design is mostly sound (full ranked list by t, explicit universe, named collections) but lacks MSigDB version and a size window. Reporting names the version, design, thresholds, retained gene counts, and caveats.
